chairs.name: 刘方辉
chairs.bio: 刘方辉，上海交通大学自然科学研究院与数学科学学院副教授，数学学院与人工智能学院博士生导师，之前在英国华威大学担任助理教授。研究方向为机器学习数学理论与大模型机理分析。其主要研究工作包括函数空间视角下的机器学习理论、尺度扩展下的泛化理论，并进一步推动理论指导实践的研究范式。2023年入选国家高层次人才青年项目，2024年获得AAAI新教师奖，2025年入选TUM全球访问教授计划，2026年获得美国数学与统计创新研究所（IMSI）长期访问学者资助项目。研究获得基金委面上项目、英国皇家学会、谷歌的资助。主办 NeurIPS‘24，’26研讨会，担任IJCV专刊客座编辑，在 ICASSP’23、CVPR’23、ISIT’24 等国际顶级会议上主讲tutorial。担任NeurIPS、ICLR、AISTATS等会议领域主席。

talk.title: LLM for ML Theory at Scale: The VALG Agent and OpenTheoryBench
talk.speaker: 邹荻凡
talk.affiliation: 香港大学 · 计算与数据科学学院
talk.abstract: LLM capabilities for ML theory are not validated. Existing benchmarks rely on pre-formalized theorems, missing the core challenge: formulating problems from raw papers - extracting, structuring, and validating theoretical claims. We present two contributions. VALG is an agentic pipeline automating the full paper-to-proof process: contribution triage, source auditing, proof reconstruction, and rubric-based evaluation. OpenTheoryBench is an open-source benchmark built from recent arXiv papers, providing hundreds of realistic proof problems covering dependency planning, quantitative reasoning, and capability integration. Together they test novel-theorem solving and diagnose interpretation, strategy, and derivation failures. Empirical validation shows strong discriminative power, with model performance tracking task complexity monotonically. Finally, we aim to bridge informal mathematical writing and machine-verifiable reasoning, advancing AI for theoretical ML research.

paper.title: VALG: An Agentic System for ML Theory Research
paper.abstract: Abstract : …analysis, and refine both assumptions and proofs. We investigate whether this process can be organized as an autonomous agentic workflow for ML theory research. We develop VALG , an agentic system that combines multi-level Verification, Adaptive formulation of Learning-theory problems, and Graph-structured proof development. Within each source-relative theore… ▽ More Machine learning theory studies learning procedures through mathematical setups in which the data model, training protocol, oracle access, loss, metric, and randomness define the phenomenon that a theorem is meant to explain. Solving an open problem therefore requires the problem formulation, theorem target, and proof mechanism to be developed in concert. Researchers formulate hypotheses, test them through preliminary theoretical or empirical analysis, and refine both assumptions and proofs. We investigate whether this process can be organized as an autonomous agentic workflow for ML theory research. We develop VALG , an agentic system that combines multi-level Verification, Adaptive formulation of Learning-theory problems, and Graph-structured proof development. Within each source-relative theorem branch, VALG maintains a fixed mathematical specification, checks the theorem-level composition of a typed proof-dependency graph, and constructs and reviews local proofs in dependency order. When a proof attempt fails, VALG identifies whether the obstruction lies in a derivation, the proof structure, or the theorem formulation and routes the next attempt accordingly. Formulation-level obstructions initiate an explicitly related variant or relaxation, preserving the mathematical relation between the resulting theorem and the source problem. We evaluate VALG on nine subproblems from five COLT 2026 open problems. Two runs produce internally finalized theorem candidates that match the scope of their source briefs; the remaining seven yield restricted-method results, special cases, or conditional theorems. These case studies show how VALG keeps source-scope matches, relaxations, conditional results, and blocked attempts mathematically distinct. VALG is open source at https://github.com/DechenZhang/ VALG -ML-Theory-Agent. △ Less

paper.title_en: LLM for ML Theory at Scale: The VALG Agent and OpenTheoryBench
paper.note: 摘要明确介绍VALG和OpenTheoryBench两个自研系统/基准，讲者为港大助理教授，报告题目与摘要一致，推断为对应论文。

short_read:
**问题**：LLM 在机器学习理论上的能力尚未被系统验证。现有基准大多基于已形式化的定理，只测试“证明给定命题”的能力，而遗漏了理论研究的核心环节——从原始论文中提取、结构化并验证理论主张，即“问题形式化”本身。报告指出，ML 理论研究需要同时处理问题设定、定理目标与证明技术的协同演化，而现有评测无法覆盖这一过程。因此，VALG 与 OpenTheoryBench 的提出，是为了把评测从“证明已知结论”推进到“从原始文献出发构造并求解新问题”，并诊断模型在解释、策略与推导层面的具体失败模式。

**核心方法**：VALG 是一个智能体流水线，将 ML 理论研究组织为“源相对定理分支”（source-relative theorem branch）。其工作流分为两个阶段：第一阶段（形式化前）通过文献调研、视角选择与想法生成，将研究问题具体化为“定理契约”（固定数学设定与唯一目标）；第二阶段（证明与评审）采用 sketch–global–step–assembly 四步流水线：先构造带类型的证明依赖图，再做全局诊断检查定量依赖、收敛模式、对象兼容性与边界行为，然后按依赖序逐条证明局部引理，最后组装成完整手稿。失败时按定位路由到推导、结构或形式化层级的重试。在 COLT 2026 五个开放问题的九个子问题上，VALG 产出 22 个内部定稿的定理候选，其中两个与源问题范围完全匹配，其余七个为受限方法、特例或条件定理。OpenTheoryBench 则从近期 arXiv 论文构建含数百个真实证明问题的开源基准，覆盖依赖规划、定量推理与能力整合。

**与已有工作的关系**：该工作区别于形式化定理证明智能体（如 LeanDojo、DeepSeek-Prover 等），后者以固定形式化目标为前提，不处理问题设定本身的修订；也区别于数学研究智能体（如 Aletheia、Danus 等）——Danus 的共享事实图虽与 VALG 的依赖图相近，但 Danus 在目标给定后终止，而 VALG 显式区分“形式化障碍”与“推导障碍”，并允许因形式化问题生成新的源相关定理分支。与 AI4SLT 等将已有 ML 理论形式化的工作相比，VALG 更早介入，在定理目标尚未固定时工作，并可将定稿分支交给形式化验证流程。

**贡献与边界**：主要贡献是把“未形式化的 ML 理论研究”建模为可评测的智能体任务，并提供了区分源范围匹配、弱化结果与失败分支的评测框架。边界方面：论文评估仅基于 COLT 2026 开放问题的子问题，样本量小且结果多为内部定稿，未给出外部同行验证；OpenTheoryBench 的构建细节与评测指标在官网摘要中未展开。依赖假设包括：源问题需有可检索的文献支撑、定理契约需能形式化表述，且智能体对“源范围”的判断依赖人工或模型对原始问题的理解——若源问题本身模糊，分支分类的可靠性会受影响。
